texts: Every Keeper considers that sky-cats are sacred.
Sky-cats sometimes carry a nightmoth to the spires in flight.

fields.sentence: Every Keeper considers that sky-cats are sacred.

review.notes: Universal over a kind takes the event-rule form at 1.0/0.9 with its QuantifierPhrase companion; the non-factive attitude seals P under Theme with no top-level predication of sacredness, and only the definitional sky_cat genus projects out of the seal (noun modifier 'sky' correctly not exposed).

Strength-0.0 distributing rule for "never", the dependent Skolem object (sk_sky_cat $x) with its typing kept inside the rule, and the sky_cat genus (noun modifier not exposed) all follow the instruction set. The companion's word slot is the one ambiguity: the Quantifiers parenthetical ("with its companion as 'no'/'none' already provides") can be read as prescribing "no"/"none" rather than the surface "never" recorded here.

fields.sentence: Sky-cats sometimes carry a nightmoth to the spires in flight.
parse: (: skycat_carry_rule (Implication (Member $x sky_cat) (And (Member (sk_carry $x) carry) (Agent (sk_carry $x) $x) (Theme (sk_carry $x) (sk_nightmoth $x)) (Member (sk_nightmoth $x) nightmoth) (Goal (sk_carry $x) sk_spire_1) (In (sk_carry $x) flight))) (STV 0.5 0.9))

review.notes: Frequency dial (sometimes 0.5), companion, dependent Skolem moth, Theme for carry, Goal for 'to the spires', the definite plural as a group witness, and both solid/hyphenated compound genera are all as the instruction set specifies. 'in flight' answers no where/when/how-adverb question, so the preposition-named oblique (In <event> flight) with a bare-noun constant is the licensed fallback.
